title: RaskAuthorFacet
description: The subject a rask lakehouse event was authored by, as a principal key (<idp-id>~<subject>). It rides the run of a RunEvent and the dataset of a DatasetEvent. A producer stamps the subject it authenticated, and lineage's HTTP door overwrites it with the subject of the caller's verified token.

name.description: A display name for the author; rask's producers write the principal key here too.
